narration.text: Brand24. Social listening. Twenty-five million sources. Mentions. Sentiment. Share of voice. Reports.
A Team seat: three hundred forty-nine dollars a month.
Rebuilt on Monid. One key. One balance. Seventeen hundred tools, paid per call.
Reddit. YouTube. TikTok. Instagram. Google Maps. News. Voice, too.
This is sonar. One brief: a brand, three competitors, fourteen days, ten sources.
Forty-two calls. Three hundred forty-one mentions. Sentiment and share of voice, each with an interval.
Topics. A spoken summary. Every number cited to a real post.
Total: two dollars and twenty cents. Four briefs a month: eight dollars eighty-one.
Thirty-nine point six times under the seat.
When data is thin, sonar abstains. Our own label audit, zero point eight four, printed on the receipt.
The receipt is the product. The code is open. Hashtag monid.
